mcp_tools.name: decision_trap_sweep
mcp_tools.title: Decision-trap sweep
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared decision record; get a deterministic TRAP_CLEAR / TRAPS_PRESENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE sweep across seven trap sections (framing and classification, options, criteria before evaluation, evaluation and uncertainty, pre-mortem, rush and mood trap, decision log and review) with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The declared decision record (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

framing.description: Framing/classification evidence (decision stated, decide-by, constraints, out-of-scope, classification reversible|irreversible, stakes).

criteria.description: Criteria evidence (listed, defined and weighted before scoring).

evaluation.description: Evaluation evidence (method named, uncertainty flagged, probabilities estimable, expected value used).

premortem.description: Pre-mortem evidence (materiality declared, conducted, top risks hedged).

rush.description: Rush/mood evidence for irreversible decisions: {made_in_rush, made_in_a_mood} — both must be false.

log.description: Decision-log evidence (choice, rationale, assumptions, review date, communicated with why).

expect.notes: All boolean flags set to true/false as required for an irreversible decision. Computed spot checks: 3 options provided (>=3 required).
